content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Working with Directories and File Metadata** as part of **Exceptions, Files, and Input/Output**. Catch or represent expected failures at a boundary where the program can respond usefully; do not silently swallow errors or expose secrets in messages. Use the subtopics—Listing Files, Checking File Attributes, Creating and Removing Directories—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Real projects depend on reliable error handling, modular organization, reproducible builds, and safe language boundaries. This lesson helps turn isolated syntax into maintainable applications.
